name: Gaon Gil
source:
"...Don't misunderstand. I didn't help you. I just protected our school's reputation."

Current Student Council President.

One of the top 3 geniuses of National High School. Diligent and deeply trusted by everyone as the student council president. He doesn't harbor good feelings toward the protagonist, believing she has undeniable talent in programming but has given it up and lives as she pleases.
